name: South Carolina
source: gun-policy Season 3 Stage 5, South Carolina session A hand-over (sc/HANDOVER-A.md part 7), 2026-11-14
sessions: Two-year General Assemblies (e.g. the 125th, 2023-2024; session number nnn in scstatehouse.gov paths, e.g. sess123_2019-2020). A bill keeps its number across both years. House bills are numbered from 3000 up, Senate bills from 1 up. House 124 seats, Senate 46.
bill_data: LegiScan bulk datasets are on disk; never re-pull a dataset. LegiScan per-bill calls only.
Bill texts fetch direct from www.scstatehouse.gov as .htm pages (no LegiScan call needed), e.g. /sess123_2019-2020/prever/3058_20181218.htm.

votes.floor_rule: LegiScan motions read 'House: Passage Of Bill' / 'Passage Of Joint Resolution', 'Senate: 2nd Reading' / '3rd Reading', concurrence ('Concur In Senate Amendments'), 'Adopt Conference Report' and 'Override Veto'. Keep those; drop amendment, tabling and procedural motions. The official vote history numbers roll calls '[H]-1066' style.
gaps: The Senate often has two kept floor votes on one bill (2nd and 3rd Reading).

LegiScan pads every bill number to four digits (S0109, H3594) and names a bill page by the session's first year (H3594 of 2024 is /H3594/2023). With the datasets on disk the vote tools read both from the datasets; the flags cover a live LegiScan call.

texts.marks: HTML pages mark changes three ways: <strike>/<u> tags, inline style="text-decoration: line-through|underline", and (most often) <span class="sc_strike"> / <span class="sc_insert"> (also scstrike / scinsert) styled by grouped CSS selectors in the page head. Legend: 'Indicates Matter Stricken' (struck) and 'Indicates New Matter' (new). Convert to [-struck-] and [+new+]; a converter that reads only the tags misses most marks. Pages declare charset="utf-8". An amended section is headed 'SECTION n. Section nn-nn-nnn of the S.C. Code is amended to read:'; a new one 'by adding Section ...'.
texts.note: A change mark can split one word (e.g. S[+LED+], subsection[+s+]), so a quote of that word does not match verbatim. robots.txt allows all but images, dashboard and sys (2026-11-14).

search_note: Vote history: https://www.scstatehouse.gov/votehistory.php?...&billnumbers=<n>&session=<nnn>&chamber=H|S (301 to /votehistory, 200), one row per roll call with the motion, date and yeas/nays (2026-11-14).
bill_table_note: Texts mark struck words [-struck-] and new words [+new+]. Never read [- -] text as something the bill does, except as what it removes; only [+ +] words in an amended section are new.
quirks: Most change marks are CSS classes (sc_strike / sc_insert), not tags.
A mark can split a single word.
